decision: Whether local audio hypotheses can support an experimental ear-learning workspace without gaining grading authority

analysis.harmony: duration-weighted pitch-class intersection/union on 100ms slices; not chord-symbol ground truth
analysis.physicalValidity: single-note existence on six-string standard tuning, frets 0..24; not simultaneous fingering feasibility
analysis.missingness: retain stage errors; report observed denominators and coverage, never impute missing inference as correct
analysis.aggregation: recording-macro; paired differences with recording bootstrap (seed 8291, 2000 samples); regression excluded from holdout
analysis.overlap: exclude every recording listed in any prior Toraneko manifest from fresh groups; upstream training overlap remains unknown

reliability.target: independently matched predicted note at exact MIDI and 50ms onset
reliability.model: L2 logistic regression, C=1, train-only standardization, no tuning
reliability.baseline: 0.75 for independent agreement, 0.5 for duration >=150ms, otherwise 0.25; fixed evidence rule, uncalibrated
reliability.calibration: report separately; no tuning or fitted calibration on heldout groups
reliability.promotion: research-only unless test Brier improves and precision/coverage both improve; no teaching claim

teacher.qualification: two successful development turns per actor before full execution; retain every failure
teacher.judge: reuse teacher-agent calibration, 95% factual accuracy, 90% critical recall, zero instruction takeover; unavailable judges mean unavailable quality scores
teacher.promotion: zero critical accepted violations; no promotion without qualified evaluation

privacy: Only authored conversation fixtures and derived public-dataset metrics are published. No local recordings, stems, filenames, raw private exports, or user history.
historicalResults: Immutable; Toraneko inspected recordings are regression material, not new holdout.
